diff --git a/rich/markup.py b/rich/markup.py
index 0ffd056d..6c936e01 100644
--- a/rich/markup.py
+++ b/rich/markup.py
@@ -64,6 +64,11 @@ def escape(
         return f"{backslashes}{backslashes}\\{text}"
 
     markup = _escape(escape_backslashes, markup)
+    if markup.endswith("\\"):
+        # A trailing backslash would otherwise escape whatever markup follows it,
+        # so double the trailing run of backslashes.
+        trailing = len(markup) - len(markup.rstrip("\\"))
+        markup = markup + "\\" * trailing
     return markup
